name: Ente-Web
description: The Ente Photos web app (plus the public-albums, accounts, auth and cast apps) for your self-hosted Ente instance. Requires a running Ente-Server (Museum) container - install that template first. Set ENTE_API_ORIGIN below to the URL where clients can reach Museum, e.g. http://YOUR-Unraid-IP:8080 Ports: 3000 Photos (main app), 3002 Public Albums (shared links), and optionally 3001 Accounts (passkeys), 3003 Auth, 3004 Cast. Setup guide: https://github.com/YoshiroMaximus/Unraid-templates

ports.name: Public Albums Port
ports.description: Public album sharing app. Needed for shared links; must match apps.public-albums in museum.yaml.

ports.name: Accounts Port
ports.description: Optional Accounts app, used for passkey-based 2FA.

ports.name: Auth Port
ports.description: Optional Ente Auth (2FA codes) web app.

ports.name: Cast Port
ports.description: Optional Cast app for slideshows on TVs.

variables.name: ENTE_API_ORIGIN
variables.description: URL where browsers/devices can reach the Ente-Server (Museum) API, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080 or https://api.example.com - do NOT use localhost unless you only browse from the server itself.

variables.name: ENTE_ALBUMS_ORIGIN
variables.description: URL where the public albums app is reachable, used when generating share links.
